distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) records Yunnan, including Lijiang. Smith et al. (2022) independently records Yunnan. This additional source supports the existing reviewed distribution without changing it.

host_note: Pistacia weinmannifolia is retained as a species-level host from Smith et al. (2020). Smith et al. (2022) provides no host in the curated record, so no host update is made.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cyclorhipidion inarmatum (Eggers, 1923).
